'''Tripwires''', light traps and [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensors]] were all used on [[Peppel]], around [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] in an attempt to heighten his simple hut's security.
